summary: VCI Global Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement amending an existing equity line of credit (ELOC) purchase agreement with Alumni Capital LP. It decreases the maximum Purchase Shares to 2,485 and Warrant Shares to 16,718, all previously issued and sold, reflecting 1-for-60 and 1-for-15 reverse stock splits. Total proceeds received were $26,980,364.28. This is a routine registration filing, not a special situation. No strategic transaction, tender, divestiture, or activist event is involved. The filing merely adjusts registration amounts for already-completed sales under an existing agreement.
